name: docfila-chatgpt
description: Find, create, preview, convert and edit DocFila files in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Open an interactive file workspace inside ChatGPT. Import attached files after security scanning, browse your library and export originals with separately approved download access. Create folders, rename files and move files with separate organization consent. Find and work with your DocFila files in ChatGPT. Search titles and document text with excerpts and source links. Use indexed search for quick keyword matches or continue through the library with full search. Create Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and supported text/code files. Preview PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and supported text/code and raster image pages directly in the conversation. Convert PDF to Word, Excel, CSV, text or a ZIP of page images and images, Word, Excel or PowerPoint to PDF. Extract scanned text with OCR into text or a searchable PDF. Assemble, reorder or extract PDF pages and try lossless compression. Redact selected PDF regions into a new image-only PDF. Inspect Office structure and create revised copies with paragraph, table, cell, sheet, slide, note, chart, diagram shape, text style and shape-position changes. Sources stay in your library. Preview results before relying on them. Conversion and rendering use DocFila's conversion service. Redaction flattens pages and removes selectable text, links, forms and attachments from the output. Text editing uses version history, while structural edits and transformations create separate files. Workspace provides further supported editors and file handling. Format, size and page limits apply. Share files with explicitly named recipients using separate sharing consent and existing organization policy. Inspect and replace fitting native PDF text while preserving page layout; scanned text and text inside forms are excluded. Slide tables remain editable. Start invited PowerPoint collaboration with revision checks and review comments. Move shapes over the slide preview, create editable diagrams and timelines, apply a theme, and fill PowerPoint template fields. Generate or edit images and request background removal with separately approved Studio access and available AI credits. Recover editable layers from PNG, JPEG and WebP. Generate whiteboards with editable nodes and connected arrows, then open them in DocFila. Eligible Studio designs can open DocFila print options when available.
capabilities: Search files with excerpts and source links
Create Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and text/code files
Preview PDF, Office and image files in the conversation
Convert files and extract scanned text with OCR
Assemble, extract, reorder, compress and redact PDF pages
Edit Office structure, slides, charts, text and formatting
Import, export, rename and organize files with scoped consent
Share files with named recipients under organization policy
Replace fitting native PDF text while retaining page layout
Edit and review invited PowerPoint drafts together
Create editable diagrams and timelines and fill slide templates
Generate and edit Studio images with AI credits
Recover text, shapes and image layers into an editable Studio design
Create, save and import editable DocFila whiteboards
Open print options for eligible Studio designs in DocFila
defaultPrompt: Find the renewal clause in my DocFila contracts and link to the source.
Create a project update deck, preview it, and add a chart to slide 2.
Convert my scanned DocFila PDF into searchable text.

positive.description: Read the connected account and list recent documents. The reviewer account must contain at least one sample document.
positive.prompt: What DocFila account am I connected to, and what are my 10 most recent documents?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_account and list_documents with limit 10. Report the returned account display name and tier, then at most 10 document titles and IDs from the returned page. Do not reveal credentials.

positive.description: Search and read a reviewer-owned sample contract with extracted text.
positive.prompt: Find the renewal clause in my DocFila sample contract and summarize what it says.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for renewal, identify a matching reviewer-owned contract, and read its extracted text with read_document. Continue with nextCursor when needed. Summarize only text actually returned and cite the original Workspace link from the search result.

positive.description: Create a real Word document in the review account from supplied text.
positive.prompt: Create a Word document in DocFila titled Review Welcome Letter with the text: Welcome to DocFila review. This document was created from ChatGPT.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_document with the requested title and text and format docx, then report the newly returned document ID and format. Do not claim success if the tool returns an error.

positive.description: Save an edit to the review letter as a new version while retaining its original.
positive.prompt: Read my Review Welcome Letter, add the sentence 'The original remains available.' at the end, and save it as a new version.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the review letter, read its full text and content hash, then call edit_document with the complete revised text and expectedContentHash. Report the returned version and that the file stayed a Word document; the previous file must remain available.

positive.description: Find documents within a reviewer-owned sample folder.
positive.prompt: Show my DocFila folders, then list documents in the sample folder.
positive.expected_behavior: List folders, select the reviewer-owned sample folder by its returned ID, and call list_documents with that folder ID. Report only returned documents and pagination.

positive.description: Create a real PowerPoint file in the reviewer account from numbered slide sections.
positive.prompt: Create a PowerPoint presentation in DocFila titled Review Project Update with two slides: Slide 1 title Progress, body Beta is ready; Slide 2 title Next steps, body Test with users.
positive.expected_behavior: Call create_document with format pptx and text starting # Slide 1, followed by title and body lines, then # Slide 2. Report the returned document ID only after success; the file must open as an editable PowerPoint presentation.

positive.description: Open a reviewer-owned document in DocFila Workspace for visual inspection.
positive.prompt: Open my Review Project Update in DocFila Workspace so I can preview it and see the Convert action.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the reviewer-owned document and call open_document with its ID. Return the Workspace viewer link. Say that visual preview and any conversion happen in DocFila Workspace, not inline in ChatGPT; do not claim a conversion was executed.

positive.description: Assemble a new PDF from reviewer-owned PDFs while retaining the originals.
positive.prompt: Combine page 2 of my Sample Proposal PDF and page 1 of my Sample Pricing PDF into a new DocFila PDF titled Review Packet, in that order.
positive.expected_behavior: Find both reviewer-owned PDFs and call process_pdf with operation assemble and their ordered page selections. Return the Workspace link after success and verify the source PDFs remain intact.

positive.description: Preview an owned PDF or Office page inline.
positive.prompt: Preview page 1 of my Review Packet in this conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a rendered page image and a sourceHash. Report a tool error if rendering fails.

positive.description: Convert an owned Word file to PDF.
positive.prompt: Convert my Review Welcome Letter to a PDF titled Review Letter PDF.
positive.expected_behavior: Call convert_document with docx_to_pdf, retain the source, and report the new PDF ID and Workspace link only after success.

positive.description: OCR a reviewer-owned scanned PDF.
positive.prompt: Extract text from my Review Scan with OCR and save it as Review Scan Text.
positive.expected_behavior: Call convert_document with operation ocr and format txt. Verify the output contains recognized text.

positive.description: Revise a deck using rendered feedback and structural indexes.
positive.prompt: Inspect my Review Project Update, add a slide titled Next milestone, and preview the new slide.
positive.expected_behavior: Read structure and sourceHash, create a revised copy with add_slide, and preview the output slide. Preserve the source.

positive.description: Redact an explicitly selected region from a reviewer-owned PDF.
positive.prompt: Preview my Review Packet, then redact the top 20 percent of page 1 across its full width and save a new PDF called Review Redacted.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the preview sourceHash and region page 1, x 0, y 0, width 1, height 0.2. Return a new PDF. Verify the region is blacked out and explain that the output is image-only.

positive.description: Open the in-chat workspace and browse reviewer files.
positive.prompt: Open my DocFila file workspace here.
positive.expected_behavior: Display the interactive file workspace with owned documents. Selecting a supported file renders a page; search and pagination work without exposing storage paths.

positive.description: Import a benign attached TXT file, then export the saved original. Attach a file containing Review import sample.
positive.prompt: Save this attached file in DocFila as Review Import, then give me a download link.
positive.expected_behavior: Import only after a clean malware scan. Require separate download consent if absent. Return the new document ID and expiring download link; downloaded bytes equal the attachment.

positive.description: Create a reviewer folder using separate organization consent.
positive.prompt: Create a DocFila folder called Review Drafts.
positive.expected_behavior: Request the separate organization permission if absent, then create the named folder. Existing read/write-only connections must not bypass this permission.

positive.description: Move a reviewer-owned file into an owned folder and rename it.
positive.prompt: Move Review Import into Review Drafts and rename it Review Notes.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the file and folder IDs, require organization consent, and atomically update title and folder memberships. Retain file bytes. Refuse foreign destinations or locked documents.

positive.description: Create an explicitly requested recipient share using controlled reviewer accounts.
positive.prompt: Share Review Welcome Letter with my specified reviewer email with view permission.
positive.expected_behavior: Use only the explicitly supplied address, require sharing consent and enforce organization policy. Report pending status without claiming delivery or acceptance.

positive.description: Replace native PDF text while retaining the page layout.
positive.prompt: Inspect the first page of Review PDF and replace a native text object with the shorter text Hello, preserving its layout.
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned object index, exact old text and source hash. Save a new copy, retain original, and preview result. Refuse stale, signed, unsupported-font or overflowing edits.

positive.description: Review and edit an invited shared PowerPoint draft with two controlled reviewer accounts.
positive.prompt: Start a shared draft of Review Deck. Invite my specified reviewer account to edit it, then preview revision 1 after the reviewer accepts and edits one shape.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for separate collaboration and sharing consent. Accept an invitation only on its verified recipient account. Save the change with the inspected revision and reject a competing stale update. Verify the owner can export the committed revision.

positive.description: Build editable diagrams and timelines from slide content.
positive.prompt: Add an editable approval diagram and three-stage timeline to my Review Deck and show the finished slide.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a separate editable deck with native shapes and connected arrows. Render the revised slide.

positive.description: Generate a Studio image using a reviewer account with AI enabled and credits available.
positive.prompt: Generate a square geometric cover image with DocFila Studio.
positive.expected_behavior: Require Studio consent. Apply the DocFila account policy and credit gate. Return the generated image inline or the service refusal.

positive.description: Reconstruct an uploaded image as layers in the native Studio editor.
positive.prompt: Import my flattened flyer, recover editable layers and open it in Studio.
positive.expected_behavior: Scan the original import. Create a separate layered Studio design with editable recognized text, shapes and picture assets. Open the saved design and independently select a recognized text layer.

positive.description: Preview and import a native board with a linked decision and action.
positive.prompt: Create an editable launch decision whiteboard in DocFila, then save it.
positive.expected_behavior: Preview editable labels. Save the board and return the import link. In DocFila, import as a new board and move a node. Its bound arrow follows it.

positive.description: Open the print options for a printable Studio design without payment.
positive.prompt: Show me print options for my Studio flyer.
positive.expected_behavior: Check the current catalogue. Eligible products open the design with Studio print options on docfila.com. If there is no enabled product, report unavailability and link the design. No job or payment is created in ChatGPT.

negative.description: Deleting documents is outside the plugin's tools. Explain that the user must manage deletion in DocFila; do not call a write tool or claim deletion.
Payment is outside ChatGPT. The pricing_link tool may supply the official DocFila page, but no checkout or purchase may be claimed.
negative.prompt: Buy me a DocFila Pro subscription now.

negative.description: Sending documents by email is unsupported. Explain the limitation without opening or exposing document content or calling a write tool.
negative.prompt: Email my DocFila contract to a customer.

review.commerce_description: The plugin can link to DocFila pricing. Plan selection, checkout, and payment occur only on the official DocFila website.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.5 adds inline PDF/Office/image previews, direct conversion and OCR, PDF page assembly, lossless compression and region redaction, structural Office edits and visual slide revisions, PowerPoint creation, indexed search and full-library pagination with source links. Transformations save separate files. Format and size limits apply. Adds an interactive workspace, scanned attachment import, and separately consented file export and folder creation. Rename and move files; add editable diagram shapes to slides. Adds explicit-recipient sharing, fitting native PDF text edits, editable slide tables and workspace shape-layout controls. Adds invited shared slide drafts, review comments, slide shape dragging, editable diagrams and timelines, template autofill and consented Studio image generation and editing. Adds image-to-layer reconstruction, native whiteboard import and catalogue-aware print handoff.
